## Enhancements
- **The 6-bit vision Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B now drafts out of the box.** The download catalog adds `Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX-6bit-vision-DFLASH2`: the 6-bit vision build with the DFlash2 draft model packed in, every file byte-identical to its source. It takes about 28 GB on disk and about 29.5 GB of model memory, so a 48 GB M5 Mac holds the model and its drafter whole. Measured against the plain 6-bit vision build on such a Mac at temperature 1.0, short replies decode about 1.16 times faster (89.4 against 77.3 tokens a second); after a 10,011-token prompt the two run about even. Macs without an M5 GPU, and memory limits too low for the drafter, decode exactly like the plain build. The plain 6-bit vision build stays in the catalog.
## Compatibility
- Existing configurations, installed models, conversations and settings are preserved; the configuration schema is unchanged. - macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
## Distribution
Signed with a Developer ID under Hardened Runtime, notarized by Apple and stapled; the Sparkle update is EdDSA-signed over the final bytes and served from a signed feed.
Tracked in #2383.
